_meta.description: BattleScout AI dataset — BattleBots heavyweights (250 lb). Weapon/archetype/builder are stable public facts. `wins`,`losses`,`koRate` are SEED ESTIMATES intended to be refreshed from live public pages via the Bright Data pipeline (scraper/scrape.mjs). Unlike static hardcoded datasets, these fields are designed to be re-scraped after each 2026 Pro League episode.
_meta.recordsNote: Seed estimates; run `npm run scrape` (Bright Data Web Unlocker) to populate with live records.

bots.name: Orbitron
bots.note: Billed as the first fully AI-controlled combat robot in the 2026 Pro League. No track record yet — the season's wildcard.
